PancakeSwapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every configured PancakeSwap V3 pool via on-chain NFT enumeration (NPM is ERC721Enumerable). Thin subclass of UniswapV3PoolsMeta overriding _slot0() to decode PancakeSwap V3's uint32 feeProtocol ABI plus the protocol-id slug. NonfungiblePositionManager pinned in the constructor; the active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (nav-config instances). 04 reads positionManager/protocol. Disabled: COW on Base has no feed, so a WETH/COW pool's COW leg cannot be valued — the adapter drops any instance whose tokens aren't both registered. Enable + add pool instances once COW is priced.
